items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Sharky and, uh, Leon Prima opened that place up the first time. It was Sharky and Prima's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well it proves to you that, uh, you, uh, never know why, why I, I, uh, wanted, because I was something different that night. I played something different. I didn't play anything he played. He played something, I come out with something. No. Well the things that I played that, that night, the people never heard them, maybe. And that's, that's what won the contest, I think. Of course it was a big deal in them days. I think, just to pay about $4 a night. That was big money. Uh, Elysian Field, uh, and, uh, St.…
Yeah, I would like to know some more about that band that Sharky and Leon Prima had together. Who was in there with them?
